title: General Available: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28)
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 wave 1 (BC28) is now generally available with version 28.0, featuring production and sandbox environment management improvements in the Admin Center. New customers automatically receive BC28, while existing customers will be notified when updates are available.
key_points: BC28 (2026 wave 1) is generally available with platform 28.0.48222.0 and application 28.0.46665.48257
New customers automatically sign up for BC28; existing customers receive email notifications for updates
Production and sandbox environment management capabilities added to Admin Center
BC25 (2024 wave 2) update cycle changed to 5-month major updates and optional minor updates
On-premises version 28.0 downloads delayed but coming shortly

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 wave 1 (BC28) is generally available.
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the official release date and version number for the 2026 release wave 1

quotes.text: Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows significant change to update cadence for BC25 with longer intervals and flexibility
